messages:
Maria: Quick sync — we need to lock the boundary semantics for hosted/dedicated/private telemetry and auth before the next RFC merge. thoughts?
Liam: +1. main tension is: how much auth context the runtime adapter can assume vs what control plane must pass.
Sophie: Do we want the runtime to accept a short-lived signed token blob or full customer creds?
Raj: Prefer signed token blob (minimal surface). Less risk for private deployments.
Olivia: Agreed. For Dedicated we still need tenant-id + allowed-models list in token.
Dennis: We also need to decide where sampling decisions for telemetry live — runtime or control plane?
Maria: Proposal: control plane decides sampling policy, runtime reports according to policy header. runtime can locally sample fallback when header missing.
Liam: That matches our reliability goals. implies a small protocol: headers for sample-rate and sampling-id.
Sophie: Example header sketch: `X-RW-Sample: rate=0.01;id=abc123`
Raj: Can we keep that header opaque and let runtime forward to observability sink with added labels?
Olivia: For Private installs customers may want to disable forwarding. We need a per-deploy flag.
Dennis: Ops note: if runtime does local sampling, we should include a compact provenance blob so we can tie logs to request without PII.
eng-bot: Deploy-checklist: ensure token-rotation support + header passthrough implemented in shim (PR #).
Maria: Action items: 1) Liam to write proto for token blob and header contract. 2) Sophie & Raj to sketch threat model for blob. 3) Olivia to add per-deploy telemetry toggle to Feature Matrix.
Liam: I can produce proto by EOD Thurs. proto will be minimal: tenant_id, exp, scopes[], sig.
Sophie: Threat model note: evaluate replay + signing key compromise. propose short TTL + rotation.
Raj: Also include optional `origin` field so runtime can mark hosted vs dedicated vs private in telemetry without leaking account id.
Olivia: UX: control plane toggle defaults to ON for hosted, OFF for private, configurable for dedicated.
Dennis: Ops: ensure we emit a metric when headers missing so we can detect old clients.
Maria: OK — if nobody objects I'll paste a short stub in the RFC branch after Liam's proto. objections?
Liam: none.
Sophie: none.
Raj: none.
Olivia: none.
Dennis: none.
Maria: Great. I'll follow up with meeting notes and assign the DRI labels. :thumbsup:
